children: The Malaysian oil and gas sector-related exposure should continue to attract investors as Middle East disruptions are expected to persist through year-end, Kenanga Investment Bank analyst Peter Kong and his team say in a note. While higher interest rates, partly driven by higher energy prices, may weigh on technology and other rate-sensitive sectors, oil and gas-related stocks could benefit from Middle East disruptions. Shipping company MISC is Kenanga's preferred stock. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
